2. Move from [20, 10] to [25, 10] (to the right, just below the vertical barrier).
3. Move from [25, 10] to [25, 22] (up to avoid the vertical barrier).
4. Move from [25, 22] to [30, 22] (to the right).
5. Move from [30, 22] to [30, 25] (up).
6. Move from [30, 25] to [40, 25] (to the right to reach the goal).
